verdict.rationale: Composio's Triggers feature delivers structured event payloads (new Slack message, GitHub commit, incoming email, etc.) to a webhook you control, which is the event-detection half of the story, but the docs describe only event delivery, not a built-in rules engine or automatic action-execution layer inside Composio itself — the 'rule' and resulting action logic must be implemented in the consuming app/agent, not defined declaratively in Composio. Missing for 10: evidence of a native rule/condition-definition interface, automatic action dispatch without external code, and any first-party or community proof of end-to-end trigger-to-action automation working reliably.
